prompt: Complete the wordCounts method so it returns a Map of case-insensitive word counts, with every key stored in lowercase.
explanation: A HashMap is the standard collection for counting: keys are the distinct words and values are how many times each appears. Lowercasing every word before using it as a key is what makes the count case-insensitive. getOrDefault(key, 0) reads the current count (or 0 the first time), so one line both starts and updates each counter.
hints: Create a HashMap<String, Integer> and loop over the words array with a for-each loop.
Call word.toLowerCase() once per word and use that lowercase string as the map key.
counts.getOrDefault(key, 0) + 1 gives the new count whether or not the key is already in the map; put the result back with counts.put(key, ...).
